header.streamHint: Streams are never merged; switching opens that market's primary security
header.quoteRemoved: Quote row and K-line are hidden (the quote chain has no replay contract yet)
header.replayError: Latest filing for the replay date failed to load ({code})

replay.label: Replay
replay.ownershipNote: Issuer, securities and identifiers in the header reflect today's ownership
replay.dcfHidden: Valuation model is not run in replay
replay.readsDisabled: Read receipts are off in replay

states.noIssuer: This security is not yet registered in issuer master data, so there are no disclosure facts.
states.noFacts: No disclosure facts yet (not in sync scope or not synced yet).
states.hkPending: Hong Kong disclosure facts await the document pipeline (F3). No third-party figures are substituted.
states.beforeFirst: No disclosures were visible as of this date.
states.truncated: Read truncated; partial data is not shown
states.truncatedDetail: truncated = true: the grid is not rendered at all. Reduce the number of periods and retry.
states.routeError: {view} failed to load ({code}). The header still shows the issuer; no other data source is used.
states.ambiguous: This code maps to several issuers (ambiguous_ticker); the disclosure stream cannot be determined.
states.viewPending: This view is wired in a later task.

statements.quarterlyBsDisabled: The balance sheet has no single-quarter basis
statements.withheldPending: {n} cells not shown: citation pending (CNINFO PDF not linked or no per-value locator). Withheld on the server; no substitute values.
statements.withheldIncomplete: {n} cells have incomplete source records (evidence missing or empty codeVersion); values are not shown.
statements.badgeLegend: Badges: R revised · n re-disclosed · U multiple units · ! citation pending (admin view only)
statements.cellPendingTitle: Citation pending or per-value check pending (citation_pending): withheld on the server, no substitute value
statements.cellIncompleteTitle: Evidence DTO missing or empty codeVersion (evidence_incomplete)
statements.cellOtherUnitTitle: Only other-unit facts exist for this period; open to see them
statements.cellOtherUnitDerivedHint: Derived quarter exists only in another unit; switch to Disclosed to see sources
statements.cellMissingTitle: No visible disclosure of this concept for this period
statements.miniBarsAria: Bar chart of {concept} by period; values are this row's cells
statements.miniBarsNote: Inline bars of the same row
statements.footnote: Cell → disclosure history (facts) or formula drawer (derived); row header → concept notes.

badges.U: Facts in other units exist for this period; see drawer

drawer.evidenceNote: Returned with the response, not fetched on demand
drawer.evidenceMissing: No evidence record for this value (withheld).
drawer.replaySteps: Replay: download bytes → check sha256 → sha256(sha256 + "\n" + hashLocator) = rawHash → read jsonPointer → replay mapping and unit transforms = value_text
drawer.withheldOnly: No value shown for this cell: {reason}. Neither the value nor any substitute source is shown.
drawer.reasonPending: filing citation = pending, or linked without a per-value PDF locator (citation_pending)
drawer.reasonIncomplete: evidence DTO missing or empty codeVersion (evidence_incomplete)
drawer.formulaMissing: Formula text missing (formula_version {version} is not in the catalog)
drawer.inputsNote: Each input opens its disclosure history.
drawer.truncated: Read truncated; disclosure history is not shown (truncated).
drawer.notFound: Fact not found (it may be disclosed after the replay date, or no longer visible).
drawer.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable; copy the query below manually.

metrics.note: Ratios to 2 decimals; money scaled; shares raw
metrics.notProducedTitle: Missing input, unit mismatch, zero denominator, ambiguous period match or version mismatch (spec 2 §8)
metrics.stale: Metrics pending recomputation: fact visibility changed after materialization. Old values are not shown.
metrics.footnote: Row or cell → formula drawer (formula, basis, inputUnit; each input opens its disclosure history).
metrics.modelDivider: Below is a model, not facts
metrics.modelChip: Assumptions include model / default / user estimates; not facts

filings.unpublishedNote: Filings with mapping_gen = 0 are not listed (no published run covers them yet)
filings.citeFailed: Linking failed, needs manual review ({n} attempts)

judgments.emptyTitle: The judgment layer (F4) is not live yet
judgments.empty: Only judgment cards registered and settleable in F4 render here. Recommendations are not shown.
judgments.none: No judgment cards for this issuer.
judgments.replayFailed: Replay read failed: response view ≠ as_known or asOf differs from the request; judgments are not rendered.

tracking.slotBody: This company's event timeline appears once the tracking module ships.

legacy.aiNote: Model-generated views; never settled or calibrated and not judgments of the judgment layer (F4). No consensus score is shown.

concepts.capex: Purchases of property, plant and equipment
concepts.capex_incl_intangibles: Payments for fixed, intangible and other long-term assets
concepts.dividends_and_interest_paid: Dividends, profit distributions and interest paid
concepts.net_change_in_cash: Net change in cash and equivalents
concepts.net_change_in_cash_and_restricted: Net change in cash, equivalents and restricted cash
